biggest_catch: Upside's official referral program does not pay a flat $15. It pays the referrer an extra 15 cents per gallon on their next gas purchase plus 10 cents every time the referred friend makes a purchase over $5 — small, volume-dependent fuel discounts, not $15 cash.
catches: Official support article (support.upside.com): the First-Purchase Bonus is an extra 15 cents per gallon on the next gas purchase and a 10% bonus on the next restaurant/grocery purchase — not $15.
Per-Purchase Earnings: the referrer gets 10 cents each time the friend makes an Upside purchase over $5 (pre-tax and tip) — earnings depend on the friend's future activity, not a lump sum.
Friend must enter the invite code before claiming any offers, then make a first purchase of $10 or more (before tax and tip).
Upside offers are location-based and vary by ZIP code; cash-out minimums apply and small bank/PayPal cash-outs can incur fees.
